name: Siberian Republic (1918)
description: A field divided diagonally from the upper fly to the lower hoist, white above and green below.
history: The white-and-green of Siberia, taken from the colours of Kazan students in 1853, was approved as the Siberian flag by the regionalist conference on 5 August 1917. The Provisional Siberian Government, which proclaimed an independent Siberia at Omsk in July 1918, flew it until it dissolved into the Ufa Directory on 3 November 1918; White Siberian forces continued to use it.

features.symbolism: the snows and the taiga of Siberia
